sloka: हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु भरतः केकयीसुतः ।निवेशयामास तदा समृद्धे द्वे पुरोत्तमे ।। ७.१०१.१० ॥
transliteration: hateṣu teṣu sarveṣu bharataḥ kekayīsutaḥ ।niveśayāmāsa tadā samṛddhe dve purottame ।। 7.101.10 ॥

translations.english: After all those (Gandharvas) were killed, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, then established two prosperous and excellent cities.
